title: Quick heal / quick mana / quick buff keys and Life Fruit gating
player_outcome: H drinks your best healing potion, J your best mana potion and B every buff potion you're not already under, without changing your held item, just like Terraria. Life Fruit only works once you've reached 400 max life.
design: Verified: input.json has no quick_* actions; Life Fruit only caps at 500 (data/items/alchemy.json:56).
input.json: quick_heal key:H, quick_mana key:J, quick_buff key:B (listed for rebinding).

New ItemUseSystem.Quick.cs, QuickHeal(p): among backpack stacks with HealLife, pick the smallest heal ≥ missing life, else the largest. Respect potion sickness; Consume that slot via a slot-aware ConsumeAt(p, inventory, slot).
QuickMana(p): same idea over HealMana. QuickBuff(p): every stack with a Buff not already active and not food-conflicting (well_fed family), consumed once each.
Each quick use sets PlayerEntity.LastUsedItem + UseSerial++ with a short animation, so PlayerAvatar plays the drink action for that item.
InteractionController handles the three actions, calls the Quick methods and raises Used for sounds.
ConsumeParams.RequiresLife (int): Consume returns Blocked with Refused('Requires 400 maximum life') when BaseLife + BonusLife < RequiresLife.
Data: life_fruit gets requiresLife 400. Potions and boss summons get maxStack 9999 (1.4.4).
data_changes: maxStack 9999 on potions, boss summons, life/mana crystals (verify current values per item)
tests: QuickUseTests: with lesser/healing/greater potions and 60 missing life, QuickHeal picks the healing potion; the selected hotbar slot is unchanged; blocked while potion sickness is active
QuickUseTests: QuickBuff applies two different buff potions once each
QuickUseTests: life_fruit is Blocked at 100 max life and works at 400
Smoke basic.cmds: 'give lesser_healing_potion 2' / 'hurt 50' / 'press quick_heal on' / 'wait 0.1' / 'press quick_heal off' / 'wait 0.3' / 'assert player.life > 50'
risks: H/J/B may conflict with P2 bindings (housing menu, etc.); confirm the input plan.
